synopsis: Great Britain operates under the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008, which govern which machines may be sold [f2126, f15489]. The regulations (SI 2008/1597), as amended, retain existing European machinery law and impose general essential health and safety requirements and conformity obligations [f15490]. Chapter 3 records designation of the EN 474:2022 family in August 2026; the glossary specifies a notice dated 8 August 2026 and explains that designation gives a presumption of conformity under the regulations [f2126, f15244]. The glossary distinguishes HSE’s workplace-safety enforcement role from the regulations’ machine-sale role and identifies UKCA as the British conformity mark that replaced CE marking after EU departure [f15489].
